Snow settles on the widgets and app icons of your home screen.

Deep Interaction is an Android accessibility service. It tells Snowhush where the widgets and app icons of your home screen are, so snow can settle on them.

Snowhush reads only how your home screen is laid out. It never reads any other app, and it has no network access.

On the next screen, choose Snowhush and turn it on. If Android calls it a restricted setting, open the app's info page, tap ⋮, then Allow restricted settings.
Lets snow settle on the widgets and app icons of your home screen. Snowhush reads only how the home screen is laid out, never any other app, and has no network access.
Nudge it until the snow sits right on top of your icons.
Tilt your phone and the snowfall drifts that way. Shake it to blow the drift away.
Draws every frame at your display\'s full rate. Uses more battery.
